A NEW MODEL FOR CONSULTING

New questions need different perspectives.

Technology is changing what organisations can do. Understanding what they should do takes research, judgement and a close understanding of the work itself.

koralli is a research-led consulting practice. We bring Oxford researchers and experienced operators into one team, alongside yours, to rethink how work gets done.

FIG. 01 / A NEW WAVE

01 / THE QUESTIONCOPY FOR REVIEW

Yesterday’s operating models are becoming liabilities.

The risk is not failing to adopt AI. It is using AI to make yesterday’s organisation faster.

AI gives organisations the opportunity to reconsider how work is organised: what machines can take on, where human judgement matters, and how decisions are made.

Making that work requires changes to responsibilities, processes and controls, supported by data that people and machines can trust.

02 / WORK IN PRACTICECASE COPY FOR REVIEW

WORKING WITH A GLOBAL BANK

A clearer picture of delivery.

“koralli told us something we hadn’t thought of before.”

A senior leader at a global bank

A global bank wanted to understand how its technology projects were performing.

Its records used different definitions and did not add up to a dependable view of delivery.

Working alongside the bank, we agreed meaningful measures, reconciled the underlying records and built a shared view of performance.

READ THE STORY ↗
03 / THE ORGANISATION

We start with the organisation.

Introducing AI changes more than the tools people use.

It raises questions about who does the work, who makes decisions and who is accountable.

We help organisations work through those questions, from their operating model to the data underneath it. That includes deciding where agents can take on more of the work, where human judgement should remain central, and how the two work together.

WHAT WE WORK ON

  • Measuring delivery performance

    Agree useful measures and build a dependable view of delivery.

  • Governing AI agents

    Set responsibilities, evaluations and controls for agents in use.

  • Making data ready for people and agents

    Resolve inconsistent records, definitions and ownership.

  • Redesigning work for people and agents

    Rethink tasks, handovers and decisions, then test the new arrangement.

FOUR CONNECTED LEVELS

From the boardroom to the data foundation.

04 / HOW WE WORK

Specialists working on the same question.

Research and operating experience belong in the same team from the start.

Our researchers and operators bring different expertise to the work. They investigate the question together, alongside the people who will use what we build.

We work in short cycles, sharing progress and testing ideas with your team as we go. What we learn shapes the next step. You stay involved throughout, with the knowledge and tools to take the work forward.
